On 30 January 2023, she reached her career-high singles ranking of world No. 52. Liu has won one singles title and one doubles title on the WTA Challenger Tour as well as six titles in singles and one doubles title on the ITF Women's Circuit . In 2017, she was the world No. 1 in the junior rankings, after winning the Wimbledon girls' singles title, and finishing runner-up at the French Open . Liu also won a junior Grand Slam doubles title at Wimbledon with Usue Arconada in 2016. Personal life [ edit ] Liu grew up in Thousand Oaks, California. Both her parents are Chinese immigrants .
